posts.name: Sumedhik Bandyopadhyay
posts.cooked: I had to recently format my PC due to some hardware issues, and haven’t been able to access the VM machine since. I’ve tried the same procedure as shown in the 1st live session as well as the other alternative ones, but to no end. Any suggestions?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Make sure to create a new ssh key (note down the name of the key, it might be ed key instead of rsa)
Upload that key (public key) to the website
Use that key to ssh to the server

Let us know if this works

posts.name: Sumedhik Bandyopadhyay
posts.cooked:
Its working fine, if I try on a laptop, where I’ve previously done so, but its not on the PC

The id_rsa.pub key is not getting created in the .ssh folder, some other key is, and even if I get past the first stage, the second stage of copying the ssh command and executing it results in Permission Denied Error

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Yes it might create an ed key instead of an rsa key. That is also perfectly valid
